title: Design System: KVN Store — Clean Minimal Light

body.purpose: Existing shared storefront text; separate retained interfaces keep their own typography.

button.purpose: Existing default shared button size and weight; hero and compact variants remain distinct.

eyebrow.purpose: Existing uppercase eyebrow styling; hero overrides remain in source.

shadows.name: shared
shadows.purpose: Existing --kv-shadow for shared panels, cards, and button hover.

shadows.name: bssr-shared
shadows.purpose: Existing --shadow in ../kvnstore/src/public/css/common.css; scoped to BSSR administration.

motion.name: bssr-controls
motion.purpose: Existing BSSR control transitions; reduced-motion rules remain in sibling source.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Existing shared primary button; CSS variables inherit from src/shared/colors.css.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--kv-primary); background: var(--kv-primary); color: var(--kv-white); border-radius: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 22px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--kv-primary); box-shadow: var(--kv-shadow); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kv-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Existing white-backed shared secondary action, including on gray panels.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--kv-control-border); background: var(--kv-white); color: var(--kv-primary); border-radius: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 22px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--kv-white); box-shadow: var(--kv-shadow); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kv-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Existing shared text-field appearance with ink placeholder and blue keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--kv-control-border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--kv-ink); background: var(--kv-white); min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 13px; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; caret-color: var(--kv-primary); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--kv-secondary-text); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kv-primary); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Fallback
components.description: Static CSS fallback of the existing light storefront navigation; the source retains graphics animation and responsive behavior.
components.html: HomeCatalog
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; max-width: 100%; gap: 4px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--kv-secondary-text); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--kv-primary); color: var(--kv-white); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--kv-ink); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page']:hover { color: var(--kv-white); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kv-primary); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Existing non-interactive shared badge; it has no hover or focus state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 25px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--kv-surface); color: var(--kv-ink); border: 1px solid var(--kv-line); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Existing shared non-interactive panel with surface fill and soft ink shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--kv-line); padding: 28px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--kv-shadow); background: var(--kv-surface); color: var(--kv-ink); min-width: 0; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-panel-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--kv-secondary-text); }

narrative.overview:
A white canvas, light gray surfaces, dark ink, and one blue action color define the approved light appearance. This documents the implemented color change across the storefront SPA, React administration, and EJS BSSR administration; the existing compositions, density, typography, imagery, and interactions remain authoritative.

Shared frontend colors live in `src/shared/colors.css`; component styling lives in `src/shared/styles.css`. The retained Material UI themes are `src/app/theme.tsx` and `src/app/MaterialTheme/index.ts`. Server-rendered administration belongs to the sibling `../kvnstore` repository, with shared colors in `../kvnstore/src/public/css/common.css`. This document records that boundary without moving its source into this repository.
keyCharacteristics: Exact approved light palette with blue actions.
Ink for readable small text and light gray for supporting surfaces.
Existing layouts, typography, media, motion, routes, and behavior preserved.

rules.name: The Readable Small Text Rule
rules.body: Muted gray measures 3.623:1 on canvas and 3.327:1 on surface, so essential small text uses ink. Action blue measures 4.697:1 on canvas and 4.313:1 on surface; frontend text links on gray sections blend into the surface and use Surface Link Blue at 5.112:1 contrast instead of a white backing. Disabled controls are the intentional muted-text exception.

dos: Do use the approved tokens and existing frontend or BSSR aliases for their documented roles.
Do use ink for essential small text and Surface Link Blue for text actions on gray sections.
Do preserve existing layout, typography, media, motion, state labels, routes, and functionality.
donts: Don't use muted gray for essential small labels, descriptions, or placeholders.
Don't introduce a dark mode, extra accent palette, or derived color ramp as part of this color system.
Don't treat these component snapshots as authorization to redesign retained interfaces.
